args.proposed_answer: B. left lower lobe pulmonary atelectasis
args.risk: The spine sign is classically associated with left lower lobe pathology on lateral CXR, but earlier VLMs suggested RLL opacity. Need to reconcile the spine sign finding with the prior RLL consensus and confirm if the opacity location truly indicates LLL atelectasis.
